Curated local-model catalog for ItsJustCAD's Model Setup. Text entries are LLAMAFILE builds (Justine Tunney / Mozilla): a single self-contained executable that IS the server — no external llama.cpp/llama-server on PATH, cross-platform. The app spawns the downloaded file with `--server --port

--nobrowser` (see local_runtime.rs). VERIFIED against the live HuggingFace repo: URL serves bytes (206 on a ranged GET), size = git-LFS `size`, sha256 = the git-LFS `oid sha256:` from the /raw/main/ pointer. To add/refresh: GET https://huggingface.co//raw/main/ and copy the oid + size. `params` is the model's real parameter count (shown in the UI). `tier` gates the UI recommendation; `ram_gb_min` is the model's real comfortable RAM floor and gates the Install button. `runtime=llamafile` selects the self-contained spawn path. VISION entries use `runtime=gguf` with a SECOND projector artifact (`mmproj_url`/`mmproj_sha256`/`mmproj_size_bytes`): the weights + CLIP projector are served by a llama.cpp `llama-server` (on PATH) with `-m --mmproj `, exposing the same OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The mmproj trio was verified exactly like the weights (ranged GET 200 + locally computed `shasum -a 256` + byte size of the downloaded file); the gguf path requires the user to have llama.cpp's `llama-server` installed (build_command errors clearly if absent).
